description: (0.5.0, Draft) The result is embedded only for allowlisted tools (RFC-ACDP-0019 §5).

input.note: Run the proxy in front of a stub MCP server that returns the mcp-001 CallToolResult for tools/call regional_fraud_rate, against a test registry.

expected.behavior: Without an allowlist entry, data_refs is [] and embedded is false.

data_refs is one DataRef {type: primary_result, format: json, embedded: {encoding: json, content: <hashed result>}}, embedded is true, salted is false, and result_hash is the unsalted hash of that content.
A result whose JCS exceeds 64 KB is never embedded inline: the proxy uses an external DataRef if configured with a location, else publishes unembedded and salted.
